# 3 bed detached house for sale

> Campbells Auctioneers are delighted to present this attractive three-bedroom detached property to the open market. Occupying an elevated position in the peaceful rural surroundings of Croaghnamaddy, the property enjoys beautiful lake views and a quiet setting while remaining within convenient reach of Dungloe town and its many amenities.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Energetická náročnost: C2
- Lokalita: Croaghnamaddy, Dungloe
- Cena: 279 950 €
